notes: This release makes the warnings that protect your ledger tell the truth. The dashboard could say "Backups are overdue — the last one was never taken" while the Backup screen listed seven backups sitting in the folder: the app kept a note of the last backup and cleared that note whenever the ledger's structure was upgraded, which erased the only record it had. Backups are now read from the folder itself — the files are the fact — and an upgrade still makes one due immediately, but now says why: that an older backup would restore the older structure. The "Last backup" line also moves the moment you take one, instead of showing the previous backup until the screen is reopened. A backup attempt that FAILS — the keychain cannot open your passphrase, the folder has gone, the disk is full — is now said on the dashboard the same day, rather than sitting on the Backup screen while everything looked healthy for another week and a half. The off-site encrypted copy has its own warning, because the backup on this machine can be perfectly healthy while the copy that would survive this machine has not been written for weeks. And the restore fire-drill now finds this organisation's own newest backup reliably in a shared folder. Nothing about your books changed: no migration, no posting rule, no report.
